correctness.rationale: For full-support pure-state probability laws, a continuous linear combination of purities has zero variance iff it is constant on every pure state. Product probes fix its constant; a Bell pair on sites j,j+h produces the cut indicator B_h(j,s). The translated h=1 matrix has Fourier multiplier z^(j-k+1)(1+z^k); for 2k<n the h=k+1 multiplier is z^(j-k+1)(1+z^(k+1))*sum(r=0..k-1)z^r. If the first vanishes then z^k=-1, z≠1, the second equals 2z^(j-k+1)≠0. The stacked cut incidence rank is therefore n. If n=2k the only Fourier kernel is the k-dimensional half-shift antisymmetry, equivalent to Schmidt equality P_(s+k)=P_s. Bell probes attain each affine dimension. Independent exact rational SymPy matrix ranks for all n=3..14 and admissible k agree; finite tests cannot replace the all-n Fourier proof.
